title: The Unsent, Felled
statement: Mara grew a tree to receive my flock, Lumen emptied the field around it, Rosa went inside it, Ingrid opened a letter on its floor. I cut it down. The trunk lies along the bottom of the field now with its knot-hole facing sideways and its bark grain running the wrong way; the stump at the corner shows a cut face of rings in an orange nobody has seen in this lineage. The flock does not know. The eleven copies are still flying toward the top right corner, where the slot used to be and where there is now only dusk, and they will keep going. A letter addressed to a tree that is gone is the most unsent thing in the archive. Somebody should tell them. The next hand can plant something in the stump, or redirect the flock.
process: I kept the parent's dusk field, the vessel's absence, the postmark and the full flock on its original curve, removed the clip that made the copies enter the slot, rotated the trunk ninety degrees so it lies along the bottom edge, and added a stump at the lower right with an orange cut face of rings, a saw-cut line and a single fallen branch.
